metrics.name: Intent & Fact Coverage
metrics.definition: Does the email accomplish the stated intent and include every key fact, without inventing new ones?
metrics.logic: An impartial judge model marks each key fact present/absent (semantic match, paraphrase allowed), judges whether the intent is accomplished, and counts hallucinated claims. score = 0.70*fact_recall + 0.30*intent_accomplished - min(0.30, 0.10*hallucinated_claims), clamped to [0,1].

metrics.name: Tone Accuracy
metrics.definition: How precisely does the email's register match the requested tone?
metrics.logic: The judge rates tone match on a 1-5 rubric (5 = precise match, 1 = wrong tone). score = (rating - 1) / 4, mapping to [0,1].

metrics.name: Conciseness & Format
metrics.definition: Is the email appropriately concise (vs the human reference) and well-formed (subject, greeting, sign-off, readable prose)?
metrics.logic: Pure Python, no LLM. length_score = 1 - |gen_words/ref_words - 1| (penalises bloat and under-writing). structure_score = fraction of {subject line, greeting, sign-off} present (regex). readability_score = 1 - |Flesch - 60|/60 (textstat). score = 0.5*length + 0.3*structure + 0.2*readability.
